title: International Master Gunner Conference 2026
slogan: Connecting Master Gunners. Sharing Expertise. Advancing Gunnery.

about.title: The conference
about.body: The International Master Gunner Conference 2026 gathers Master Gunners and gunnery specialists to exchange doctrine, training methods and operational experience. Five days at the Cavalry Barracks in Santa Margarida — connecting professionals who keep the gunnery craft alive across nations.

barracks.title: Cavalry Barracks
barracks.body: The Quartel da Cavalaria in Santa Margarida is the home of the Portuguese Cavalry Arm — a living garrison of crews, horses and armour. Delegates will work on a military installation with controlled access, in the landscape of the Tagus valley, a short drive from Tomar.

practical.title: Practical information
practical.body: Working language: English. The barracks is a restricted military area — bring a valid identity document and follow the joining instructions issued by the organisation. Dress: service uniform or equivalent for official sessions; smart casual for social moments. Further details will be published with the programme.

programme.title: Programme
programme.body: The conference programme (sessions, ranges, social events and timings) will be published here as a document. Open it in the viewer or download it for offline use.
